title: Bulk Scope Confirm
summary: States exactly how many records a bulk action will hit and defaults to this page only, so "select all" doesn't hit every record.
description: States the exact count and risky subsets ("including 12 you don't own"), defaults to only the selected items on this page, and locks Confirm if the match count changes while the dialog is open.
catches: "All matching" scope when only this page was meant (page is the default)
Risky subsets inside the selection, counted by category
The match count changing while the dialog is open, which locks Confirm until acknowledged
limits: Counts and categories come from your props; it does not query the data
Drift is only noticed when you pass updated counts while it is open
a11y: Scope choice is a fieldset with a legend and labelled radio options
The summary and the drift warning are aria-live="polite"
Confirm uses aria-disabled while locked, aria-busy while pending and aria-describedby to the drift warning
Breakdown and sample lists have aria-labels
server: Resolve the scope on the server at execution time, check the count you confirmed, and authorise each record.
mistakes: applied to all pages not just this
